goal: agentfiles sync says a copied Claude Code or Cursor skill changed when its content changed, instead of printing "= claude skill" because the recorded source path matched.
changed: agentfiles/targets.py: _sync_copies prints = only when the recorded source path matches and a digest of the existing copy equals a digest of the source; _copy_digest walks a tree the way _copy_dir copies it (links followed, dangling links and COPY_IGNORE names left out), and COPY_IGNORE is now shared by both.

tests/test_agentfiles.py: an edited path source prints (updated) for claude skill and cursor skill while untouched skills print =, and a skill with followed symlinks, a dangling link, .git, .agentfiles-complete and __pycache__ re-syncs as = until a file behind its symlinked folder changes.

claims.claim: After an in-place edit of a path source, the next sync prints "+ claude skill: alpha (updated)" and "+ cursor skill: alpha (updated)" instead of "=", other skills print "=", and the sync after that prints "=" again.
claims.check: tests/test_agentfiles.py test_claude_skill_line_reports_a_content_change (stub claude) and test_cursor_skill_line_reports_a_content_change: fail on b88af63 with "= claude skill: alpha" / "= cursor skill: alpha" after the edit, pass on 6f23035; 10 of 10 loop runs pass.
claims.remaining: Claude Code runs through a stub CLI in the tests; the line is printed before any claude command, so the stub does not change it.

claims.claim: On an already synced install the fix marks nothing as changed that main does not.
claims.check: bin/agentfiles plan --offline with the same config from main and from this branch on the maintainer's real HOME: identical output, every copied skill line still =; state.json hash unchanged by both runs.
claims.remaining: Only the result is kept: the full output names that machine's setup. No timing cost was measurable in three paired runs.

claims.claim: The suite passes and the lock is unchanged.
claims.check: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests (124 tests, OK); bin/agentfiles lock --frozen: unchanged; CliAgentsMatchAgentKitTest with AGENTFILES_REQUIRE_AGENT_KIT=1: OK.

next.item: Check whether Claude Code serves an edited path skill after sync: the generated plugin's version and the marketplace digest hash skill paths only, so a content edit changes neither and no marketplace update runs.
next.source: inferred from agentfiles/targets.py _write_marketplace (version from d.claude_links, digest from manifest and native fingerprints)
next.why_now: Same root as this bug: change is decided on paths. Not proven: the version cache folder on one machine held no skills, so Claude Code may read the marketplace folder directly.
next.impact: If it caches by version, edits to local agent-kit skills never reach Claude Code until a path changes.

release.note: agentfiles sync now prints "(updated)" for a Claude Code or Cursor skill whose content changed, instead of "=".
